Package com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.web

package com.mobybank.harness.interfaces.web
The HTML endpoints behind index.html, the htmx page served at /. Each endpoint answers with a fragment of HTML (rendered from the Qute templates in src/main/resources/templates) that the page swaps into itself. The page's paths start with /api; its api-base setting maps them to /ui, so the JSON API in interfaces.rest and its OpenAPI contract stay separate.

Like the REST layer, this one depends on the application layer only (see WebLayeringTest).
